admission.censoring: failed or null charged calls are censoring records and never numeric negatives; the recovered pack already excludes them from the score column, so this corpus contains no imputed failure value
rules: the row must carry a finite numeric docking score
the row must join to exactly one archive construction (entry_alternatives == 1)
the row's cell must be one of the fifteen declared cells
the row's checkpoint file must be bound by the frozen checkpoint manifest
the row must carry an input state identity and an endpoint
admission.unit: one (cell, entry_id, protocol) construction with at least one charged score

payload.authorizing_milestone: AGENTS.md T4 autonomous-search strategy reset, 2026-09-16: keep learned proposal-prior training explicitly separate until its split-clean data and actual-sampler support are verified.

coverage_gate.decision_rule: GO only if every hard criterion holds and every required family is dense in every fold's training side; otherwise ABSTAIN and report which family or criterion failed. A failed gate is a negative result and is not widened.
coverage_gate.disclosure: the pooled, fold-blind block-label census of the pack was inspected while scoping this contract; the per-fold census that this gate reads had not been computed when the thresholds were frozen
coverage_gate.required_dense_family_source: the generic constructions named in REPORT sections 4 and 5 as the ones the measured successful BRAF/5HT1B/JAK2 genealogies and the JAK2 Full-146 decomposition actually used; chosen from that pre-existing document, not from a per-fold count

folds.claim_boundary: held-target folds measure generic transfer of the corpus, not a held-out benchmark result; a deployed checkpoint fit on all cells remains trained-on-T4
folds.rationale: the prior is declared target-free, so the honest held-out unit is a whole protein; no endpoint, input state, entry id or protocol crosses a target in the recovered pack

grouping.enforcement: the builder fails closed if any listed identity appears under two cells; this is an invariant assertion, not a tuned threshold
grouping.lineage_rule: genealogical_parent edges are closed into connected components inside a cell; a component is never split across folds because a cell is never split

checkpoint_manifest.role: binds the local raw checkpoint mirror that a later within-fold fitting step must resolve program payloads from; recoverable from the Modal volumes named in diagnostics/t4_strategy_reset/20260916/recovery_manifest*.json

labels.aggregation: mean over repeated receipts of one (cell, entry_id, protocol) unit
labels.comparison_rule: scores are comparable only within one protocol
labels.direct_endpoint: measured QuickVina docking utility, lower is better
forbidden: imputing a score for an unscored proposal
labelling a structural neighbour with a scored molecule's utility
treating repeated serialisations as independent observations
labels.known_limitation: REPORT section 7 measured median repeat range 0.2 and p90 2.9 docking units; magnitudes are noisy, so a later fit must use within-context ranking rather than raw differences

prohibitions: no Modal launch and no live-run access
no vocabulary, feature moment, density or model fit in this milestone
no modification of any existing artifact, contract or running experiment
no candidate lock and no scored launch authority
payload.question: Can the recovered historical T4 charged observations be organized into a leakage-audited, group-split corpus that actually supports a small joint context-conditioned program/binding/parameter proposal prior, and which generic construction families does it support?

weights.policy: equal total mass at every level, divided uniformly at the next level
weights.rationale: adaptive search over-represents productive lineages and long runs; raw record-uniform weighting would let one cell and one genealogy dominate
